name: What does a roof valley assessment process involve?

mainEntity.name: What does a roof valley assessment process involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our roof valley assessment process typically begins with a visual inspection from the ground to identify obvious signs of damage or debris. Next, our technicians carefully access the roof to conduct a detailed examination of the valley flashing, shingles, and underlying materials. We look for signs of wear, corrosion, cracks, or improper sealing. During the assessment, we photograph any damage to provide a clear overview, which helps you understand the extent of any necessary repairs or maintenance. This thorough approach ensures all potential issues are identified.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes ground-level and on-roof inspections, examining flashing, shingles, and underlying materials, with photographic documentation of any damage.
